jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

Early Careers IT Support Engineer Programme
jobs.description:
Life on the team

Have you caught the IT vibe yet? Are you passionate about technology and do you like helping people?

We offer you a seat in our 3-month Early Careers IT Support Engineer Programme 2026. This programme is designed to give graduates their first steps in the world of IT. We provide you excellent hands-on training to kick start your career with a dedicated training plan. You can apply at anytime, starting as of November.

This exciting, frontline IT Support development program will allow you to develop your soft skills and technical knowledge within IT Support. You will take a deep dive into the innovative world of IT, with clear career paths and a purpose from the start.

If you love the sound of that, this is the opportunity for you!

What you'll do

• An in-depth 3-month IT Support training programme
• You will get the chance to rotate as an IT Support Engineer at different locations with several of our national and multinational organisations
• You will be provided a platform where you can learn the necessary skills to be successful
• You will be supported by a company mentor who will guide you throughout the programme
 

What you'll need

• You are IT degree educated and passionate about technology
• You are self-motivated with a keen interest in IT Support
• Willing to take initiative and be hands-on
• You work well in a team and have the desire to succeed
• Good communication skills, both verbal and written in English and good command of Dutch and French
• You are free from November to start the 3-month Early Careers IT Support Engineer Programme
• You have a valid driver's license B

Java fluency means you can develop, test and maintain any application that’s written in Java. It means your Java code is clean and efficient and you can assist cross-departmental teams with your interpersonal fluency to deliver high-quality software solutions. You’ll use Java frameworks like Spring and Hibernate, and tools like Maven to navigate databases, version control systems (like Git), and innovative methodologies with agility. Your problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to adapt to evolving technologies and project requirements mean you’ll have no trouble debugging and resolving issues in your day-to-day work, or adapting to the requirements of the cutting edge projects Sopra Steria delivers.  

Our Developers specialise in application and software development while seamlessly integrating systems, so we never lose sight of our business goals. With an eye towards user experience and productivity, you’ll design, code, and test new functionalities while troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and keeping technical documentation in order. Our developers love to design and are always informed of the latest design trends. When fulfilling day-to-day tasks, you’ll always be ready with a solution when there’s a problem. You’ll also collaborate with other teams and never miss a detail so you can deliver solutions that meet Sopra Steria’s quality standards. 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

• Java
• The Spring Stack (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Cloud)
• Testing (unit, integration, acceptance)
• Cloud (AWS or Azure)
• DevOps
• Scrum
• Kanban 
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• 
Languages: English (required), French and/or Dutch desirable

We are Team possible – the people behind Davinsi Labs, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Codit, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here!
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world. 
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do. 
Sounds like your kind of place?

Your job

What can you expect from this role? 

You will be part of our MSP teams focusing on Managed Detection and Response (MDR). The SRE team focuses on the backend platformization and automation side of the MDR service. Aspects like reliability, scalability, automation and efficiency of our managed service provider (MSP) technology stack are extremely important for Davinsi Labs. Your primary objective as an engineer will be to continuously enhance these capabilities across different complex customer environments. Your expertise and performance will directly impact the experience of our valued clients. The most relevant technologies for the SRE team are the following ones: 

• AWS
• GitHub
• Nutanix Prism
• HashiCorp Terraform
• HashiCorp Vault
• HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)
• Ansible
• Microsoft Entra ID
• Microsoft Azure
• PingIdentity PingOne for customers
• Rocky Linux
Key responsibilities: 

• Design and implementation: You will be designing and implementing zero-touch production concepts across all levels of our MSP technology stack, leveraging applications Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Enterprise Security, Cribl Stream and Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR automation and orchestration capabilities to enhance operational efficiency. You will also be designing and implementing cloud infrastructure architecture, with a focus on AWS, Nutanix Prism, Microsoft Azure and Rocky Linux. This also includes IAM solutions, such as Single Sign-On (SSO), based on Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Automation: You'll develop automation capabilities for all value services, through CI/CD pipelines design and development.
• Version Control & Release Management: You'll be managing version control effectively using platforms such as GitHub. On the other hand, you'll be utilizing release management tools to streamline software deployment processes.
• Secret Management Solutions: Implementing secret management solutions like HashiCorp HCP Vault for MSP backends.
• Documentation: Generating and automating documentation using tools like Atlassian Confluence to ensure comprehensive system documentation. 

Your profile

 Hello, is it me you're looking for? 

• You have a strong background in computer science, computer engineering, or IT security (a degree is an asset).
• Experience with some of the following technologies: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Rocky Linux, Ansible, HashiCorp product portfolio, Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Experience with one or more of the following is highly recommended: Git, Atlassian Jira, Atlassian Confluence, Python v3, JavaScript.
• Affinity with threat detection platforms like SIEM technologies (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Stack, etc) and/or XDR technologies (Microsoft Defender XDR, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, etc) is an asset.
• You communicate in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. French is an asset.
• You are a problem solver with an analytical mind. As a team player with a positive attitude, you are always ready to challenge and to be challenged.

As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company

jobs.description:
Our client plays a key role in establishing the future of renewable energy in Belgium and Europe. Join a vibrant and an international environment with a great work-life balance.

Jobomschrijving

 In this role you will report to the head of finance and will be carrying out the following tasks:

• Lead the accounting function and ensure compliant financial reporting.
• Own the month-end and year-end close process.
• Manage, coach, and develop the accounting team (2 direct reports).
• Ensure accuracy and integrity of the General Ledger.
• Lead external audits and coordinate with auditors.
• Oversee Belgian and European VAT compliance.
• Advise on accounting policies and complex transactions.
• Review reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and key journal entries.
• Improve processes, controls, and accounting procedures.
• Drive finance systems, automation, and AI initiatives.

The ideal candidate matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting or equivalent 
• Minimum 7 years of experience in accounting 
• Fluent in French or Dutch and English
• Strong experience in VAT compliance and tax declarations.
• Experience with multi-country VAT registrations and compliance is a strong asset.
• Experience with Dynamics 365 is a plus
• Strong communication skills
